title: Edge of Eternities: card flavor text

entities.name: Master Iridiss
entities.description: A Drix-style master who teaches Aora the dual-sun technique.

entities.name: Aora
entities.description: A student of Master Iridiss who has yet to earn a second blade.

entities.name: Regent Maximum
entities.description: Ruler title of the Celestial Palatinate; Taman IV holds it.

entities.name: Mentor Ultimate
entities.description: A mentor who advises the Regent Maximum that light does not ask permission.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: A faith-driven company that spreads light across Sothera and is not swayed by profit.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: A realm whose cosmogrands seek to expand their grip on the Edge.

entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: A people born of dead stars who fight for light.

entities.name: Seraphus Chek
entities.description: A Sunstar poet.

entities.name: Korelaa
entities.description: A prison escapee who has forgotten sleep.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A world of storms, guarded by the Illvoi, with a godcore at its heart.

entities.name: Illvoi
entities.description: Cautious masters of cloudsculpting and the deep freeze on Uthros.

entities.name: Uthros Combine
entities.description: The Illvoi governing body that keeps scientific breakthroughs secret.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: An ancient people who weftwalk without eternity columns.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: Biotech terraformers whose seedships populated Evendo.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: An icy world thawed and populated by Eumidians.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: A people of Kavaron whose mining appetite ended their world.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The Kav homeland, a planet that is falling apart.

entities.name: Kavaron Memorial Navy
entities.description: The Kav naval force.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: A faith that fights a war of attrition and exploits Kavaron's degradation.

entities.name: the Faller
entities.description: A messiah of the Monoists whose journey leads all things to the Zero Point.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Great destroyers who annihilated civilizations across the Edge.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: A people who fell as the Eldrazi rose.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist figure who says all things end.

entities.name: Xu-Ifit
entities.description: An osteoharmonist who sees monstrousness as worth.

entities.name: Calnan
entities.description: A Monoist assassin.

entities.name: Kunthaar
entities.description: A Kav mine operator.

entities.name: Admiral Scargruf
entities.description: An admiral of the Kavaron Memorial Navy.

entities.name: Captain Mayav
entities.description: A captain of the Kavaron Memorial Navy.

entities.name: General Tekvu
entities.description: A general of the Kavaron Memorial Navy.

entities.name: Dorgan
entities.description: A Kav roboticist.

entities.name: Viya
entities.description: A Kav moxite baron.

entities.name: Zern Miffles
entities.description: A miner who did not learn the lesson about mining too deep.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A Memorial Navy ensign whose gut warns of danger.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A ship's engineer and captain who tinkers and presses ahead.

entities.name: Yvin
entities.description: A Pinnacle envoy.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: A civilization whose envoys and surveyors operate across the Edge.

entities.name: Bez
entities.description: A Pinnacle nature surveyor.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Speaks to Mm'menon about being a last resort.

entities.name: Mm'menon
entities.description: An Uthros exile.

entities.name: Exodus Day
entities.description: The day the Kav fled Kavaron.

events.summary: The Kav learned the lesson about mining too deep, but Zern Miffles did not.
events.quote: The Kav had learned their lesson about mining too deep. Zern Miffles had not.

events.summary: The Kav's mining appetite ended their world.
events.quote: The rapacious appetite that ended their world became the only means by which the Kav could lift their civilization from it.

events.summary: Those in power on Kavaron ignored the planet's warnings until Exodus Day.
events.quote: Even until Exodus Day, those in power on Kavaron refused to acknowledge that the planet was trying to tell them something.

events.summary: Falling shards of Kavaron shattered Evendo's icy shell, awakening dormant life.
events.quote: When falling shards of Kavaron shattered the icy shell of Evendo, the Eumidian seed pods were far from the only form of life awakened from slumber.

events.summary: Kavaron's degradation poisoned hearts, which the Monoists exploited.
events.quote: Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.

events.summary: The Eumidians sought weftwalking in Drix DNA but failed.
events.quote: The Eumidians sought the secret of weftwalking in Drix DNA.

events.summary: Civilizations along the Edge were annihilated by the Eldrazi.
events.quote: The Edge is littered with the vestiges of civilizations annihilated by the Eldrazi.

events.summary: The Eldrazi rose and the Fomori fell.
events.quote: His people watched the Eldrazi rise and the Fomori fall.

events.summary: Tannuk's gut warned of danger but Sami pressed on regardless.
events.quote: Tannuk's gut warned of danger, but Sami forged ahead without heed.

events.summary: The Eumidians became the natural predator of a swarm.
events.quote: The swarm lacked a natural predator, so the Eumidians became one.

relations.note: Iridiss counsels Aora to be patient until she earns her second blade
The Kav demand the Eumidians relinquish Kavaron Tomorrow
relations.quote: We will not yield until the Eumidians relinquish our Kavaron Tomorrow.
Older than the Eumidian seedships that populated Evendo.

relations.note: Illvoi nervous systems ponder the depths of Uthros
relations.quote: another might contemplate the depths of Uthros.

relations.note: Drix hunt Eldrazi Potentiate without hesitation
relations.quote: Drix hunt down Eldrazi Potentiate without hesitation or explanation.
What flavor do you want, Sami?
